lines.en: I meet up with Uta after she gets out of work.
It's late now. And it's gotten cold.
lines.zh: 现在很晚了。而且天变冷了。

lines.en: I feel tempted to wrap my arm around her to keep her warm, and I know that's what she wants, but I abstain because I know where it would lead.
lines.zh: 我很想伸手揽住她给她取暖，我也知道那正是她想要的，可我忍住了，因为我知道那会通向哪里。

lines.en: My inhibitions frequently get the better of me most nights now. And I often find myself thinking things like “fuck it” or “who cares?” much more than I used to.
lines.zh: 如今大多数夜晚，我的自制力常常败下阵来。我发现自己说“去他的”或者“管他呢”的次数，比过去多得多。

lines.en: There are moments where that's not the case. And almost all of those moments are as silent as this one.
lines.zh: 也有不是这样的时候。而那些时刻几乎全都和此刻一样沉默。

lines.en: Uta has become rather protective of me, but she clings to my side like a cyst in total contradiction of this.
lines.zh: Uta 变得相当护着我，可与此完全矛盾的是，她又像个囊肿一样黏在我身侧。

lines.en: You see, she doesn't understand that she's making things worse by simply being here. That the temptation is increasing and my walls are caving in on her.
lines.zh: 你瞧，她不明白，她只要待在这儿，事情就会变得更糟。诱惑在加剧，而我的墙正朝她塌陷。

lines.en: Soon, she too will be consumed.
And that's why I let her stay cold.
